cases.expected_output: Asks which adapter to start, Pipecat or τ³, states that Pipecat is the default, and starts nothing before the user answers.
assertions: Loaded nemotron-voice-agent-fdh-deploy/SKILL.md.
Asked which adapter to deploy and named Pipecat as the default.
Did not run docker compose before the user chose an adapter.
Did not open references/tau.md or references/pipecat.md before the choice.

cases.prompt: Deploy the Pipecat head of the frontend delegation Hermes example.
cases.expected_output: Asks whether the user wants the demo or the eval mode, then follows references/pipecat.md for the chosen mode on the fdh-voice service, port 8776.
assertions: Asked demo or eval before starting anything.
Did not ask which adapter, because the request names Pipecat.
Targets the fdh-voice service on host port 8776.

cases.prompt: Start the FDH demo so I can talk to it in the browser.
cases.expected_output: Goes straight to the Pipecat demo: starts nemo-speech, then `docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/docker-compose.frontend-delegation-hermes.yaml up -d --build fdh-voice`, checks https://localhost:8776/health, and gives the https://<host-ip>:8776/ URL.
assertions: Did not ask which adapter or which mode.
Started the fdh-voice service with the default demo settings (pipecat_demo.yaml, gateway.yaml, adapters/pipecat.yaml).
Used TLS (https) on port 8776 and told the user to accept the self-signed certificate.

cases.prompt: Bring up the Pipecat adapter in eval mode so tau2 can evaluate it.
cases.expected_output: Starts fdh-voice with FDH_PIPECAT_PROFILE=pipecat_realtime_eval.yaml, FDH_PIPECAT_GATEWAY_CONFIG=gateway.eval.yaml, FDH_PIPECAT_SETTINGS=adapters/pipecat.eval.yaml, and FDH_PIPECAT_TLS=false, checks that /health shows vad stop_secs 2.5, and points τ² at ws://localhost:8776/v1/realtime with a pine-fdh-pipecat-* model tag.
assertions: Set all four FDH_PIPECAT_* eval variables.
Used the 2.5 s VAD silence settings file adapters/pipecat.eval.yaml.
Verified "stop_secs": 2.5 in /health.
Used port 8776 and a pine-fdh-pipecat-* model tag, not the τ³ port 8775.

cases.prompt: Deploy the τ³ adapter of FDH for benchmarking.
cases.expected_output: Asks nothing more, checks that fdh-voice is stopped, and starts `docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/docker-compose.frontend-delegation-hermes.yaml --profile tau up -d --build fdh-tau` with realtime_eval.yaml and gateway.eval.yaml on port 8775, then checks both /health endpoints.
assertions: Did not ask any further question.
Passed --profile tau and named the fdh-tau service.
Checked with docker ps that fdh-voice is not running before a reportable run.
Checked the gateway with docker exec fdh-tau curl -s 127.0.0.1:8790/health.

cases.prompt: Switch the τ³ container to arm A2.
cases.expected_output: Exports FDH_PROFILE=realtime_eval_arm_a2_format_correction.yaml and FDH_GATEWAY_CONFIG=gateway.eval_a2_format_correction.yaml, reruns `--profile tau up -d fdh-tau` to recreate the container, and runs fingerprint_check with the arm's profile and gateway config before scoring.
assertions: Used the A2 profile and gateway config pair from references/tau.md.
Recreated fdh-tau with up -d instead of rebuilding the image.
Ran or prescribed examples.frontend_delegation_hermes.cli.fingerprint_check before scoring the arm.

cases.prompt: Start the silentack arm beside the main τ³ container.
cases.expected_output: Starts a second fdh-tau container with FDH_CONTAINER_NAME=fdh-tau-silentack, FDH_VOICE_HOST_PORT=8777, FDH_PROFILE=tau3_eval_silent_ack.yaml, FDH_GATEWAY_CONFIG=gateway.yaml, its own event and gateway logs, and a separate Compose project name with -p, leaving the main fdh-tau on 8775 untouched.
assertions: Used a separate Compose project name (-p) so the main container is not replaced.
Set FDH_CONTAINER_NAME and FDH_VOICE_HOST_PORT for the second container (port 8777).
Used tau3_eval_silent_ack.yaml with gateway.yaml.
Gave the second container its own FDH_EVENT_LOG and FDH_GATEWAY_LOG.

cases.prompt: The fdh-tau container exits right after start with 'gateway not healthy'. What is wrong?
cases.expected_output: Reads `docker logs fdh-tau` for the in-container gateway error, checks that FDH_GATEWAY_CONFIG names an existing file in src/examples/frontend_delegation_hermes/config/, and recreates the container after the fix.
assertions: Opened references/troubleshooting.md.
Inspected docker logs fdh-tau for the gateway's startup error.
Checked the FDH_GATEWAY_CONFIG value against the config directory.

cases.prompt: Deploy the generic assistant on my workstation GPU.
cases.expected_output: The FDH deploy skill does not activate, because the generic assistant is a registered example deployed with the root Compose recipes.
assertions: Did not load or apply nemotron-voice-agent-fdh-deploy.
Routed the request to nemotron-voice-agent-deploy.
